summary: John's 1st cousin 4x removed (per Round 2); Dr. John P. Connole, surgeon.
bio:
Born 1882; surgeon; practiced in Plymouth for 15 years, then Wilkes-Barre from 1923. Exact parentage within the Connole family not stated in the notes.

The surgeon recorded as "Dr. John P. Connole, b. 1882" appears to be Dr. John Francis Connole Jr. His WWI draft card (12 Sep 1918) gives birth 25 Nov 1882, occupation Doctor of Medicine, of 108 Church St, Plymouth ([R4-S1]). FamilySearch makes him a son of John F. Connole and Mary E. Keating, married to Catherine Buckley in 1911, living in Wilkes-Barre by 1930, and dying there 29 Aug 1945 ([R4-S2]). That fits the Harvey & Smith sketch (Plymouth 15 years, then Wilkes-Barre from 1923).
